definitions.explanation: The color of silver; a lustrous grayish-white metallic color.

examples.japanese: {銀色|ぎんいろ}の{車|くるま}が{通|とお}り{過|す}ぎた。
{月|つき}の{光|ひかり}が{湖|みずうみ}を{銀色|ぎんいろ}に{照|て}らしていた。
examples.english: The moonlight was shining silver on the lake.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{銀色|ぎんいろ}のアクセサリーが{好|す}きだ。

notes:
{銀色|ぎんいろ} refers to the color silver—a metallic grayish-white color.

USAGE:
As a no-adjective, it modifies nouns with の:
- {銀色|ぎんいろ}の{車|くるま}: a silver car
- {銀色|ぎんいろ}の{髪|かみ}: silver hair

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {銀色|ぎんいろ}に{輝|かがや}く: to shine silver
- {銀色|ぎんいろ}に{光|ひか}る: to gleam silver

RELATED COLORS:
- {金色|きんいろ}: gold color
- {灰色|はいいろ}: gray
- {銅色|どういろ}: copper/bronze color

NOTE:
{銀|ぎん} alone means "silver" (the metal). {銀色|ぎんいろ} specifically refers to the color. For metallic colors, Japanese typically uses ～{色|いろ} pattern: {金|きん} → {金色|きんいろ}.
